notes.title: New Update - further textures and lighting optimization
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! A new update is now live and ready to download, please read the full patch notes below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Global Changes:[/b][/p][p]- Correct handling of gamma settings[/p][p]- Eliminated sudden changes in display effects (jumping between post-process zones)[/p][p]- Adjustments to the display of items collected by the player [/p][p][/p][p][b]Training Mode:[/b][/p][p]- Visual improvements to Training 04, 05, 08, and 09[/p][p]Campaign – Chapter 02:[/p][p]- Fixed level loading system[/p][p]- Fixed environment rendering issues[/p][p][/p][p][b]Campaign – Chapter 05:[/b][/p][p]- Improved lighting in the level intro[/p][p]- Improved lighting during the Judgment fight[/p][p]- Adjusted special effect materials during the Magician fight[/p][p][/p][p][b]Campaign – Chapter 06:[/b][/p][p]- Visual improvements: brightened dark locations, fixed textures issues[/p][p]- Fixed environment during the Emperor fight[/p][p]- Fixed rendering issues for dynamic objects before Goldman’s room[/p][p]- Adjustments to the level loading system[/p][p]- Removed the pink flash at the start of the Emperor fight[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Completion Room:[/b][/p][p]- Fixed rendering issues[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix for THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD 2: Remake
notes.notes: [p]The first hotfix addresses most of the reported issues, and we're working on another patch that will be released later today.   A fix for the demo save bug, which causes the game to become unresponsive in the menu, is also in production.  Thank you for your ongoing feedback! [/p][p][/p]
